items.title: Sweden’s AI & Data Market: Evidence for Executive Decisions
items.description: The November 2026 review goes beyond job listings to examine AI adoption, recruitment demand, business confidence and regional conditions. Five executive perspectives, three outlook scenarios and practical recommendations draw on 43 published observations from six sources.

items.title: Historical AI & Data Market Research Sample
items.description: A public example of selected senior AI and Data advertisements from June–August 2026. It is not the current executive market review.
